secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key (console.anthropic.com → API Keys). Used by Claude photo/curb analysis in the street-parking and s2-street-journey branches.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Maps API key (Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials). Used by the Street View photo proxy in the s2-street-journey branch. Needs Street View Static API enabled.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com → API Keys). Listed in .env.example for the Realtime voice feature (batch 6, not yet built).
